metadata.description: FluentCart developer skill, shipped with its own MCP server.

plugins.name: fluentcart-developer
plugins.description: The complete FluentCart developer documentation, mirrored locally as Markdown — 593 pages covering 474 REST API operations, 49 database models, 22 hook reference pages, 11 modules, payment gateways, shipping carriers and licensing. Ships a local MCP server with 6 tools: search any page, read any heading, look up a table or a hook, and generate boilerplate. Free, offline, no account.
